subject: assign factor colours in boxplot ggplot2

messages.author: da76776cc645cd7c
messages.subject: assign factor colours in boxplot ggplot2
parts:
Hello,
I'm trying to assign factor colours for the 3 level factor - site2 -
to a boxplot in R 15.2 (ggplot2 v9.2.1).

p <- ggplot(pmon_s, aes(factor(monOrd), prop))
p + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = factor(site2),colour=c("lightgray",
"darkgrey", "black"))) + theme_bw()

And I get the message:
"Error: Aesthetics must either be length one, or the same length as
the dataProblems:c("lightgray", "darkgrey", "black")"

The plot works well without the colour specifications...

Any suggestions much appreciated.

Cheers

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: assign factor colours in boxplot ggplot2
parts:
?scale_color_manual()

You set the values for the colors in the scale, not in the geom_*(). 

You will need to load the scales package to use it in this way. 
require(scales)

Make sure you have an updated version. 

B
